body:
Read-only source finding, not application shortfall attribution. Verified pushed source4f8f598c7935d0a5cdd4a5d5ba5b49d164ae2cfc contains the same exact inventory fragment as frozen403d8a409417baa8e99e6d488c567e6b9b6acc74. See [immutable source](https://github.com/wavect/semaprax/blob/4f8f598c7935d0a5cdd4a5d5ba5b49d164ae2cfc/src/cleanup_plan/replay/lexical_replay.rs#L137-L145).

The ordinary, unselected lexical replay caller clones every returned expression identity and collects a BTreeSet before validate_exits. Its selected sibling explicitly prepays each new node. The ordinary collection has no corresponding actual per-node reservation. The inventory remains live through lexical certificate authentication. #816's named expression_facts receiving status/edge/block sets are separate; this residual was disclosed in its original partial handoffs. It must not be described as already funded by arena or unrelated conservative reservations.

Implement a caller-paid ordinary operand inventory using actual fallible backing, or an exact authenticated borrowed representation consumed at both exit validation and certificate authentication. Preserve every return-site/order/identity predicate, duplicate handling and existing diagnostic priority. Retain complete ordinary old caller independently compiled and archived. Charge actual controls, owned key backing if retained, growth overlap, traversal work and receiving lifetime before acquisition with the same ReplayBudget/ledger. Authenticate zero/spare reuse and sticky refusal. No cap changes, refunds, new authority, cleanup-vector repair, source admission widening or quota credits.

Qualification: complete old/current lexical success and malformed outcomes with all six Diagnostic fields, exact/one-short/zero/sticky work and physical refusal, every new acquisition and full Drop, foreign/restored/stale owners, nested/early/late return operands and exact source/graph/cache parity. Execute unchanged retry/normalizer owners in a later combined batch and disclose failures. No application recovery or token/RSS/cost gain is established by this source finding.

Coordinate with the selected-call custody lane before changing lexical_replay. This is a distinct caller inventory from #816; it does not establish whole-compiler funding or explain the exact application budget failures.
title: (OPT) Fund the ordinary lexical return-operand inventory
